requirement.text: Smart terminal system is tested from passenger point of view. Versatile scenarios and users are tested. Viewpoint of children is also covered.

initial_eus.title: Passenger-Perspective Testing Including Children
initial_eus.description: As a passenger, I want the smart terminal system tested from the passenger point of view, so that it is verified against how passengers actually use it.
work_items: The smart terminal system shall be tested from the passenger point of view.
Testing shall cover versatile usage scenarios.
Testing shall cover versatile user types.
Testing shall cover the viewpoint of children.

analysis.ethical_objective: Ensure the smart terminal system is validated from the perspective of the people who actually use it, covering diverse usage scenarios and user groups, including children, so that the system serves all passengers appropriately.

obligations.text: The smart terminal system shall be tested from the passenger perspective.
obligations.source_span: Smart terminal system is tested from passenger point of view.

obligations.text: Testing shall cover versatile scenarios and a diverse range of users.
obligations.source_span: Versatile scenarios and users are tested.

obligations.text: Testing shall cover the viewpoint of children.
obligations.source_span: Viewpoint of children is also covered.

constraints: Applies to the smart terminal system.
Testing must adopt the passenger point of view rather than solely a technical or operator perspective.
Test coverage must include multiple scenarios and multiple user types, with children explicitly included.
ambiguities: The source does not define what 'versatile scenarios' means or how many scenarios constitute sufficient coverage.
The source does not specify which user groups beyond children must be included.
The source does not specify whether 'viewpoint of children' requires testing with actual children or representation of children's perspective by other means.
The source does not define what testing 'from passenger point of view' entails methodologically.
The source does not specify the timing, frequency, or phase of testing.
unsupported_assumptions_to_avoid: Do not assume specific testing methods (e.g., usability testing, user acceptance testing, personas, field trials).
Do not assume specific coverage thresholds, numbers of scenarios, or numbers of participants.
Do not assume additional user groups (e.g., elderly, persons with disabilities) beyond what the source states, other than the general call for diverse users.
Do not assume legal or regulatory requirements for testing with minors.
Do not assume that testing must involve real children as participants.
Do not assume particular quality criteria or pass/fail conditions for the tests.
possible_operational_aspects: Testing is conducted from the passenger point of view.
Testing includes the viewpoint of children.

work_items.explanation: Directly restates the obligation that the smart terminal system is tested from the passenger perspective.
Expresses the 'versatile scenarios' component of O2, requiring test coverage of multiple usage scenarios.
Expresses the 'diverse range of users' component of O2, requiring test coverage of varied user types.
Directly restates the obligation that testing covers the viewpoint of children.
